recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-33943 unless a new work-group issue asks for examples or further constraints around OperationOutcome.issue.expression.
issue_request: FHIR-33943 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification Vocab change request asking CodeSystem and ValueSet $validate-code to add an output parameter named issues, cardinality 0..1, type OperationOutcome, documenting a list of itemised issues whose paths are constrained to simple FHIRPath examples such as CodeableConcept, CodeableConcept.coding[0], CodeableConcept.coding[1].display, or Coding.display.
initial_application: Jira comments identify implementation commit a12dd66a8be2e41013ad19f11a37a0685f921916 and PR HL7/fhir#2233. Git history confirms that commit added the issues output parameter to source/codesystem/operationdefinition-CodeSystem-validate-code.xml and source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml, and merge commit 940b3e7619d433d2aba77b0637e55d38547129e8 brought it into HL7/fhir.
additional_context: The active source/fhir.ini [resources] list includes ValueSet, OperationDefinition, and CodeSystem, confirming the checked operation-definition XML files are current-build inputs. Later validate-code edits touched these files for other parameters but did not remove or alter the issues parameter; git -S on the issues parameter found only the original FHIR-33943 application. The 2022-04-25 Vocab Confluence minutes independently list FHIR-33943 as resolved change required.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current CodeSystem and ValueSet $validate-code OperationDefinition sources already contain the optional issues output parameter with the requested cardinality, OperationOutcome type, and simple-FHIRPath documentation.
